spotlight._help: The home-page popup — one card with a main image and the promos listed below divided into it. "image" is the big picture; each item is a row (title, tag, cta + either a "url" OR a "workId"). Use "workId" (+ "category": Prints/Crafts) to auto-link to that product's live checkout so it never goes stale; use "url" for outside links like an auction. Delete an item when it's over, or set enabled:false to turn the whole popup off.

auctionBanner._help: Slim countdown bar at the top of every page for a live auction. Set "endsAt" to the eBay auction end time in ISO-8601 WITH a timezone (e.g. 2026-08-03T19:00:00-07:00 for 7pm Seattle). It disappears automatically once that time passes. Set enabled:false to remove it.
